player_props.selection_policy: latest valid pregame player forecast captured before puck drop; postgame revisions are rejected
player_props.scenario_policy: grade scenario probabilities only when both official starters match a recorded goalie scenario; otherwise retain alternatives without blending them
limitations: Players absent from the official boxscore are not assigned zero statistics.
DNP rows are excluded from accuracy metrics.
Unmatched goalie scenarios are retained but not averaged.

source_warnings: One or more immutable archived forecasts have no independent point-in-time source verification; their scores are descriptive and excluded from paired model comparison.
selection_policy: earliest valid pregame issuance per game/model/market
limitations: Markets from the same game are correlated.
No parameter changes or promotion from daily results.
Archive hashes verify stored forecast content; they do not independently validate captured pregame input provenance.
Descriptive scores from unverified archived forecasts are excluded from certification and paired comparison.
